name: Ana Kasparian
role: American political commentator; co-host and executive producer of The Young Turks
summary: Kasparian spent most of her career as a progressive commentator at The Young Turks, backing government health care, drug reform and campaign-finance reform. Since about 2023 she has described herself as unaligned and criticized Democratic governance on crime and homelessness, while remaining critical of Israel and of US wars abroad.
